name: Broodmother Lysrix
location: Single Player: Green Obelisk; use the tribute to teleport to the arena. This is not a boss roaming the map.
summary: The Island's spider guardian with three tiers: Gamma/Beta/Alpha. Defeat it for a trophy to open Tek Cave.
strategy: Suggestion: Megatherium uses its buff from killing minions, supported by Yutyrannus courage; good saddles and imprinting are needed.
Keep formation to avoid getting stuck among minions; the survivor carries a shotgun and spare medicine.
A standard arena allows up to 20 tames / 10 survivors; check the creature whitelist and timer in game.
rewardsNote: Element follows the Ascended table, with difficulty-specific trophies/flags and Tekgrams. Tek Foundation/Replicator at Gamma, Tek Boots at Beta, Tek Helmet at Alpha; consult the source unlock table for each component.

name: Megapithecus
location: Single Player: Blue Obelisk; teleport to the snow arena.
summary: Giant ape guardian; a separate fight on The Island, unlike The Center's double-boss fight.
strategy: Suggestion: Rex / Therizino with good saddles, supported by Yutyrannus.
Keep tames away from cliffs and narrow bridges; pull the boss to safe ground rather than push the whole team across an edge.
Thrown rocks and minions threaten survivors; bring spare armor, medicine, and ranged weapons.
rewardsNote: Ascended Element, trophies/flags, and Tekgrams; consult the arena unlock table for the correct map.

name: Dragon
location: Single Player: Red Obelisk; teleport into Dragon Arena.
summary: The Island's dragon guardian; Ragnarok's Nunatak and the Center fight do not substitute for this boss.
strategy: Suggestion: Therizino with Sweet Vegetable Cake, supported by Yutyrannus; enough food/cakes and good saddles are needed.
Fire breath remains dangerous even for high-HP tames; avoid lava and manage the team during flight/landing phases.
Survivors should prioritize armor, medicine, and a shotgun; no single HP/damage threshold applies to every setting.
rewardsNote: Element follows the Ascended table, with trophies/flags and Tekgrams. Defeating all three guardians at the same difficulty allows progression to Tek Cave.

name: Overseer
location: Pass through Tek Cave at the Volcano summit, then Hall of History to the arena; do not summon at an Obelisk. The map point below is the Tek Cave area center from Wikily, with the entrance unverified; it is not Overseer's location.
summary: The Island ascension destination after the three guardians; prepare for both Tek Cave and Overseer.
strategy: Organize tames into groups and survey lava and bends; the Tek Cave entrance closes after a short time.

The wiki lists 50 tames in Tek Cave, a teleporter limit of 20 tames per trip, and additional trips before starting the boss. Check rules in your save; a compact 20-creature solo team is a management choice, not a claim about the arena's total limit.
Overseer changes guardian forms and summons drones / defense units. Prepare armor, shotgun, ammo, and mobility; keep moving when the boss changes phases.
Single Player timers behave differently from servers; check the timer in your save. Tek Cave entrance trophies are not consumed according to the wiki.
rewardsNote: No Element drops. Ascension raises the level cap by difficulty (+5 / +10 / +15); read the survivor-transfer mechanics after the fight and back up your save before the final trip.
